name: Black Talon

frame.name: Crow's Wings
frame.description: [Heavy Attack]  : Fire a Heavy projectile attack that suppresses targets. Hitting a target already suppressed spreads the effect to nearby targets.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.description: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

flavor: "His life brought peace to the Reef. His death brings a sword." —Crows of the Black Hull

catalyst.name: Black Talon Catalyst
catalyst.description: Dealing damage to Void debuffed targets increases this weapon's damage for a short time per each type of Void debuff affecting the target.
